+Fixed: `no-invalid-position-at-import-rule` false negatives for layers with blocks
diff --git a/lib/rules/no-invalid-position-at-import-rule/__tests__/index.mjs b/lib/rules/no-invalid-position-at-import-rule/__tests__/index.mjs

+++ b/lib/rules/no-invalid-position-at-import-rule/__tests__/index.mjs
@@ -78,6 +78,18 @@ testRule({
 			endLine: 2,
 			endColumn: 23,
 		},
+		{
+			code: stripIndent`
+				@layer foo {}
+				@import url('foo.css');
+			`,
+			message: messages.rejected,
+			description: 'layer block before import',
+			line: 2,
+			column: 1,
+			endLine: 2,
+			endColumn: 23,
+		},
 		{
 			code: stripIndent`
 				@media print {}
diff --git a/lib/rules/no-invalid-position-at-import-rule/index.mjs b/lib/rules/no-invalid-position-at-import-rule/index.mjs

+++ b/lib/rules/no-invalid-position-at-import-rule/index.mjs
@@ -46,7 +46,7 @@ const rule = (primary, secondaryOptions) => {
 				(isAtRule(node) &&
 					nodeName !== 'charset' &&
 					nodeName !== 'import' &&
-					nodeName !== 'layer' &&
+					!(nodeName === 'layer' && typeof node.nodes === 'undefined') &&
 					!optionsMatches(secondaryOptions, 'ignoreAtRules', node.name) &&
 					isStandardSyntaxAtRule(node)) ||
 				(node.type === 'rule' && isStandardSyntaxRule(node))
judge_input.title: Fix `no-invalid-position-at-import-rule` false negatives for layers with blocks
